app_tagline: The best quality under your size limit · photos never leave your PC
lbl_drop:
Drop photos or folders here (or click to choose)
JPG · PNG · HEIC · WebP · BMP · TIFF
lbl_result_small: Result · {size} — not smaller than the original, so none is made
lbl_preview_none: Pick a photo in the list to see the original and the result side by side at the same scale
msg_no_photos: No photos to shrink were found
info_empty: Add photos to see how much smaller they get
status_cancelled: Cancelled. Only the photos already finished have results
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_desc: Photo Resize — shrink photos to a target file size, a long edge or a quality, saved in a _small folder next to them. Originals are never changed; location (GPS) is removed.
cli_mode: how to shrink: target (file size, default) · size (long edge) · quality (quality only)
cli_size: long edge in pixels for the size mode (e.g. 3840, 2560, 1920, 1280, 800). Default 1920
cli_quality: quality for the quality mode: high (85) · medium (75) · low (60) or a number 60-95. Default medium
cli_output: where results go: folder (_small folder, default) · suffix (name + _small)
cli_keep_png: save transparent PNGs as PNG (keeps transparency)
cli_no_recursive: do not include subfolders of a folder
cli_bad_quality: cannot read the quality: {value} (high, medium, low or 60-95)
lbl_drag_hint: drag to move when zoomed in
lbl_target_note: Picks the best quality under the target; if quality 60 is still too big, the photo gets smaller.
promise_keep: Capture date and colour profile are kept
promise_bigger: Nothing bigger than the original is made
info_estimate_note: Estimated from {n} of {total} photos really shrunk
info_estimate_exact: Every photo really shrunk (nothing saved yet)
